references.text: The Lord's offerings and dues were given to Aaron and the priests as their share, as established in the law concerning the rights of the priests.
The instruction to take a tribute from the spoils of war as a gift to the Lord, which was to be given to the priest Eleazar.
The Lord's command to Moses on how the spoils of war were to be distributed, including the tribute for the priests.
The right thigh was to be given to the priest as a tribute from the peace offering, a parallel to the tributes given to the priests.
The wave offering and the tribute that were consecrated and given to Aaron and his sons by the Israelites.
Eleazar, son of Aaron, was head over the leaders of the Levites and had oversight of the sanctuary service.
